blocks.text: Setting up your Excel environment for billing

Billing specialists need a stable and efficient workspace. Start by ensuring your macOS version supports Microsoft 365. You should run one of the three latest versions of macOS to get security updates. Keep your Excel zoom level consistent at 100 percent to avoid visual fatigue during long hours of data review.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for Mac billing tasks
Stop using your trackpad for every action. These shortcuts save minutes on every invoice.

Data integrity is the core of your work. When you import CSV files from your billing software, Excel often strips leading zeros from account numbers. Select the column, right-click, and choose Format Cells. Set the category to Text to preserve these digits. Use [Data Validation](/how-to/use-data-validation-in-excel) to create drop-down lists for status fields like Paid, Pending, or Overdue.

Comparing two lists of charges is a common task. Do not rely on manual inspection. Use the XLOOKUP function to compare columns between your bank statement export and your internal billing ledger. If you find discrepancies, use conditional formatting to highlight cells that do not match. This visual cue helps you identify errors in seconds.
How to handle common billing errors

Many specialists struggle with performance issues in large files. If your sheet slows down, check for volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET. Replace these with static references where possible. If you encounter #REF! errors, use the IFERROR function to return a blank or a zero instead of an ugly error code. This keeps your reports professional for management.

Lazur helps you stay in the flow. When you get stuck on a complex formula, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to explain how to structure your nested IF statements. If you forget where the conditional formatting menu is, ask Lazur to point to it. It draws a circle on your screen so you never have to hunt through the ribbon.

Always print your invoices to PDF before sending them. Use the Print area settings to ensure your data fits on one page. If your billing cycle requires monthly reporting, create a template with protected cells. This prevents accidental changes to your formulas. You can [protect your sheet with a password](/how-to/protect-a-sheet-with-a-password-in-excel) to keep sensitive financial data secure.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Excel files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It points at tools, answers questions, and guides you through steps so you can complete the work yourself.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently available only for macOS. A Windows version is planned for the future.

faq.question: How do I fix leading zeros in Excel on Mac?
faq.answer: Select the cells containing your data. Right-click, select Format Cells, and change the category to Text. This tells Excel to treat the numbers as characters rather than a numeric value.

faq.question: What is the best way to compare two billing lists?
faq.answer: Use the XLOOKUP function to match values between two columns. This is more reliable than manual checks and faster than the older VLOOKUP function.
